remarks: Situated on the border of Northern Westover and Lower North Stamford, this rare 1.14-acre level lot offers the perfect canvas for your vision. Flat, clear, and ready to build, the property provides endless possibilities-whether you're an end user looking to create a custom dream residence or a developer searching for the ideal site for a spec project.  With its prime location, you'll enjoy the best of both worlds: the privacy and space of North Stamford living combined with easy access to Westover, downtown Stamford, schools, parks, and major commuting routes. Opportunities like this don't come along often-secure your piece of Stamford and bring your plans to life.
